pageTitle: Monster Spots · Creatures of the Deep Guide
pageDescription: A Creatures of the Deep monster spot guide with boat position maps, Monster Bait placement photos, and tips for finding bubbles and fishing.
fieldTitle: Find your spot. Plan your cast.
fieldBody: Monster Bait helps locate monsters. If bubbles appear, cast there and wait for a bite.

step2: Use Monster Bait in the reference area and watch for bubbles.

copyFooter: Estimated from a community 26-day cycle; verify in-game. Monster Bait can help locate monsters. If bubbles appear, cast there and wait. Bait is optional.
helpSubtitle: Position your boat, look for bubbles, cast and wait.
helpPositionTitle: Map for the boat, photo for placement
helpPositionBody: Numbered markers are boat positions checked by maintainers, not a guarantee that a monster is there now. Photos show approximate bait placement areas. Use shorelines, islands, and buildings to locate spots without markers.
helpBaitBody: The Wiki calls this item Monster Bait. It first creates a large stain. At a suitable location, bubbles then indicate the specific spot where a monster may appear. The stain is not the casting target; bait placed in the wrong spot may produce no bubbles.
helpBaitOptional: Cast at the bubbles and wait for a bite (Cast and wait). Monsters can also be caught without bait. Bait helps with locating them; the monster's active hours still matter.
helpResetBody: This tool retains the original update times: 05:00 for North America and 04:00 for other regions, using device local time. The previous day's result applies until then. Yesterday and Tomorrow refer to the current reference date. This does not track live game resets.
helpAtlasBody: Choose a map and spot number. A dot marks the reference spot for the selected date. Click an image to enlarge it. Use thumbnails or the previous and next buttons to switch between references.
helpDataNote: Daily spots retain the original community 26-day cycle, which is not verified by the Wiki. Some monster entries say their old fixed schedules were replaced by random locations. Follow in-game clues and observations.
